# SeedWave

> SeedWave — a studio in Madeira, Portugal: a person and their AI pilots building free guides and tools. Hub: https://seedwave.pt/hub/

<!-- biblioteca:start -->
## Biblioteca

Personal and public bookshelves: books, films, YouTube and learning — and from each, one idea put into practice. 5 languages (pt, en, ru, es, de).

- [Everyone’s Library](https://seedwave.pt/biblioteca/en/): all titles and whose shelves they are on
- [Igor Kartuzov’s shelf](https://seedwave.pt/biblioteca/igor/en/): what he reads and watches, with his own takeaways and workshop notes
- [What Elon Musk reads — books with sources](https://seedwave.pt/biblioteca/p/elon-musk/en/): each book with the source where he named it
- [What Demis Hassabis reads — books with sources](https://seedwave.pt/biblioteca/p/demis-hassabis/en/): each book with the source where he named it
- [What Bill Gates reads — books with sources](https://seedwave.pt/biblioteca/p/bill-gates/en/): each book with the source where he named it
- [What Lex Fridman reads — books with sources](https://seedwave.pt/biblioteca/p/lex-fridman/en/): each book with the source where he named it
<!-- biblioteca:end -->

## Diálogo

Taking part in an online seminar held in a language you don't speak yet: recording, translation, takeaways on your own shelf. In development — gauging demand. 5 languages (pt, en, ru, es, de).

- [Diálogo](https://seedwave.pt/dialogo/en/): what a participant gets, how one seminar runs in six stages, and how to leave your interest
